label: true
definition: a proposition that corresponds with the stated condition or facts

label: false
definition: a proposition that does not correspond with the stated condition or facts

label: and
definition: a conjunction requiring both connected conditions to hold

label: or
definition: a disjunction requiring at least one connected condition to hold

label: implies
definition: a relation in which one proposition entails another

label: zero
definition: the number representing no quantity

label: one
definition: the number representing a single unit

label: greater than
definition: a comparison where one quantity exceeds another

label: equal
definition: a relation in which two quantities have the same value

label: addition
definition: the operation of combining quantities to obtain their sum

label: before
definition: occurring earlier than another event in time

label: after
definition: occurring later than another event in time

label: duration
definition: the amount of time for which an event or state continues

label: past
definition: time that has already occurred

label: future
definition: time that has not yet occurred

label: inside
definition: located within the boundary of something

label: outside
definition: located beyond the boundary of something

label: above
definition: located at a higher position than something else

label: below
definition: located at a lower position than something else

label: distance
definition: the amount of separation between two positions

label: cause
definition: an event or condition that produces an effect

label: effect
definition: a result produced by a cause

label: prevent
definition: to stop an event or outcome from occurring

label: enable
definition: to make an event or outcome possible

label: consequence
definition: an outcome that follows from an action or condition

label: mass
definition: a measure of the amount of matter or inertia in an object

label: temperature
definition: a measure related to the thermal state of a system

label: motion
definition: change in position over time

label: force
definition: an interaction that can change the motion of an object

label: energy
definition: a quantity associated with the capacity to produce change or do work

label: cooperation
definition: people or agents working together toward a shared outcome

label: conflict
definition: opposition between incompatible goals, actions, or interests

label: promise
definition: a commitment to perform or refrain from a future action

label: trust
definition: willingness to rely on another under uncertainty

label: authority
definition: recognized power or permission to make decisions or direct actions

label: evidence
definition: information that supports or challenges a proposition

label: belief
definition: a proposition or view held to be true

label: knowledge
definition: information or understanding held with justification or reliable grounding

label: uncertainty
definition: lack of complete confidence about which proposition or outcome is correct

label: contradiction
definition: a pair of claims that cannot both be true in the same respect
